timing.note: Pure resistance; no parasitic inductance or capacitance.

analog.note: Ideal Ohm's law at the nominal value; tolerance (±5 %) and temperature coefficient are not applied.

power.note: Dissipation is computed and warned above 1/4 W; heating, derating and failure are not simulated.

emulates: Ohm's law at the nominal resistance
testOnRealDevice: Circuits that depend on precise resistor ratios (use 1 % parts or trim)
Resistors dissipating close to their power rating
